title: Predecessor Saturation Overclaiming Counterexample
finding: Predecessor declared global saturation across 17 dimensions, but production source exhibits 5 critical unaddressed failure classes.

gaps.finding: Supervisor decision engine manages stalls and fallbacks without consulting a centralized DispatcherUncertaintyFence, allowing duplicate executions when worker heartbeat pauses but process is alive.

Resource concurrency in production is strictly filesystem path based. It lacks semantic locking for shared Git index (.git/index.lock), SQLite database files, or shared append ledgers, allowing concurrent writer corruption.

Safety gates enforce flat monetary thresholds rather than fine-grained capability tokens. A worker granted WRITE_LOCAL_SCRATCH can escalate to WRITE_PRODUCTION or NETWORK_WRITE if planner parameters change.

Lease manager tracks a single PID. On Windows, tasks launched via npm/npx/powershell/cmd spawn wrapper processes. Terminating the tracked wrapper PID leaves orphaned worker child processes writing in background.

Task approval and passport inspection occur before dispatch, but dispatch does not execute an atomic compare-and-swap on task_version, allowing concurrent planner mutations to alter task parameters post-approval.
